summary: E12 Payroll Enhancements testing completed successfully. Backend: 100% (50/50 tests passed). All E12 features working: (1) Rekap Payroll API with full data structure (period, KPIs, per-driver breakdown, SDM vs revenue), (2) Export Excel & PDF with correct content-types, (3) Generate Payout MASSAL with duplicate prevention, (4) Payroll automation (notifications scan creates payroll_reminder, event types include payroll.period_due & payroll.payout_pending), (5) RBAC backend (driver gets 403 on reports/payroll & generate-bulk). Frontend: Rekap Payroll section displays correctly in Reports page with 4 KPIs, payroll table, and export buttons. Generate Massal dialog works with duplicate prevention. Minor RBAC UI issue: driver can navigate to /app/reports URL and sees 'Laporan' menu, but cannot access data (API returns 403, shows error message). This is a UX issue, not a security issue.

backend_issues.notes: Backend 100% functional. All E12 endpoints working correctly.
